user.title: Connect to Dreame Cloud
user.description: The setup wizard tests the account and discovers compatible air purifiers before creating entities.

device.title: Select the purifier
device.description: Home Assistant will test live MiOT properties on the selected device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Dreame account
reauth_confirm.description: The Dreame Cloud rejected the credentials for {username}. Enter the current password to reconnect the purifier.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the purifier.
error.no_supported_devices: No supported Dreame FP10 air purifier was found on this account.

abort.reauth_failed: The Dreame account could not be found.

led_brightness.name: Legacy numeric brightness (snaps to supported levels)

test_connection.name: Test connection
test_connection.description: Run a live diagnostic against Dreame Cloud and the purifier, then return a report.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Dreame FP10 config entry. Optional when only one entry is configured.

read_properties.name: Read raw properties
read_properties.description: Read raw MiOT properties from the purifier and return their values and error codes.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Dreame FP10 config entry. Optional when only one entry is configured.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Optional list of siid.piid strings, for example ["3.3", "3.2"]. Defaults to every FP10 property.

start_auto_clean.name: Filter self-cleaning
start_auto_clean.description: Request U2513 filter self-cleaning. Physical completion is reflected by the status sensor, not the command response.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Dreame FP10 config entry. Optional when only one entry is configured.

manage_schedule.name: Manage power schedule
manage_schedule.description: Read-modify-write one U2513 fixed-time power schedule. The service does not execute or test a schedule on the device.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Dreame FP10 config entry. Optional when only one entry is configured.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: Create, update, delete or enable one schedule.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: One-based slot 1–5. Create uses the next slot; deleting compacts later slots.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Optional paired power-off time; only valid with action on.

repeat_mask.name: Repeat mask
repeat_mask.description: Eight 0/1 digits. Once 10000000, daily 01111111, weekdays 01111100, weekend 00000011.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the selected schedule is enabled.

device_unreachable.title: Dreame FP10 purifier unreachable
device_unreachable.description: Home Assistant could not read data from {name} for {count} consecutive polls. Last error type: {error}. Open the integration diagnostic entities or download diagnostics to investigate.
